`pob2-planner.build` was generated by the pinned, unmodified PoB2
`Modules/BuildExportPoE2.lua` `Export` function on 2026-10-15. The synthetic
selection has Ranger1, shared melee17 (with a note), weapon-set-2 melee18,
Ice Shot 17/12 linked to Fast Forward 1/0, and a Weapon1 slot note. It exercises
object passives and a bare-string support, not a real player's build.

The implementation's schema authority is GGG's Build Planner v1:
https://www.pathofexile.com/developer/docs/game#buildplanner . Passive and gem
identities resolve through the checked-in game data. The writer is only a
compatibility fixture; its Level/Quality prose convention is an optional hint,
not a field in the game schema. Inventory text is never decoded as equipment.
